name: Kit · Laptop UI reveal
description: Studio kit starter: a closed procedural laptop on a warm daylight set (S.studio daylight — sun through window mullions, sky fill, soft contact shadow) opens, the display wakes and a dashboard builds itself on screen (sidebar, KPI count-ups, a chart line drawing) — a canvas drawn from t, or your image / video — while the camera cranes down and pushes in. SaaS / product launch / feature demos; 16:9 and 9:16.
